summary: A KPI that counts from 0 to 12,480 in 1400ms with an ease-out-expo curve, so the last digits settle slowly. A Count again button replays it on demand.
use: Stat blocks and metrics sections that scroll into view, totals after a report loads, and any headline number worth a moment of attention.
spec: `MotionStage` from `@codeatlasdev/ui` with `label="Count up: a number counts from zero and eases into its total"` and `loop={3200}`
`const DURATION = 1400` with `1 - 2 ** (-10 * t)` as the easeOutExpo curve
`n = Math.round(target * ease(t))` on every `requestAnimationFrame`, `toLocaleString('en-US')` formats the digits
`role="img"` with `aria-label` states the final total once; the counting `<span aria-hidden="true">` is decoration
The `Button` `onclick` calls `run()`: pressing Count again is the takeover and re-runs the count on demand
Under reduced motion the attachment sets `n = target` and no frame loop starts

motion.property: text content (integer counting from 0 to the total)
